reason: The plugin primarily provides SSH/SFTP-backed remote workspaces with agent-accessible file operations, remote command execution, synchronization, and port forwarding; these capabilities can affect remote systems and require human review.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 和 SFTP 管理远程工作区，支持远程文件操作、命令执行、镜像同步及端口转发。
summaries.en: Manage remote workspaces over SSH and SFTP with remote file operations, command execution, mirror synchronization, and port forwarding.

capabilities: SSH connection to configured remote machines
SFTP listing, reading, writing, editing, uploading, downloading, moving, and removing files
Remote shell command execution with environment and PTY support
Bidirectional synchronization between remote directories and local mirrors
SSH local and reverse port forwarding
Local storage of machine connection settings and optional passwords
